bull.probability_evidence: Bull requires comp stabilization and an EV/Sales re-rate, but none of the four re-initiation triggers has fired: Q2 FY2026 comps were -9% (Americas -12%) and Q3 guided down 10-11% (note section 2, SEC Q2 FY2026 release), gross margin is 54.9% TTM vs the >58% trigger, ROIC is 23.7% TTM vs the >35% trigger, and FCF margin is 12.2% TTM vs the >15% trigger (factsheet-2026-10-07.md Quality table; evaluation.md triggers). The valuation support cited for the bull case (13.07% FCF yield, near-net-cash balance sheet 0.32x net debt/EBITDA, Altman Z 6.17) is present but unconfirmed by any operating inflection, consistent with the lowest of the three probabilities.

target_price_12m.cite: evaluation.md Decision block scenarios.bull.target_price_12m: EV/Sales re-rates from 1.0x toward the 1.5x peer median on slightly lower sales

target_band.cite: Half the spread of the bull target priced on EV/Sales (1.0x -> 1.5x peer median, factsheet-2026-10-07.md Valuation table, giving $135 at an implied -3.8% sales factor g=135/(93.61*1.5)=0.9618) vs. the same g applied to a full P/E re-rate to its 16.6x peer median (93.61*(16.6/7.7)*0.9618=$194.11): spread $59.11 / 2 / $135 target = 21.89%

base.probability_evidence: Base is the modal outcome because every quality metric is already falling with no stabilization evidence yet: ROIC -8.9pp, ROCE -5.2pp and FCF margin -7.6pp over 5 years, Q3 FY2026 revenue guided down 10-11% (factsheet-2026-10-07.md Quality table; note section 2) -- a trend-continuation outcome (flat multiple, further earnings slip offset by buybacks) is better evidenced currently than either a reversal (bull) or a legal/short-interest-driven escalation (bear).

target_price_12m.cite: evaluation.md Decision block scenarios.base.target_price_12m: P/E holds near 7.7x while earnings slip further, buybacks roughly offset the decline

target_band.cite: Base case holds the CURRENT multiple flat (P/E and P/FCF both 7.7x, factsheet-2026-10-07.md Valuation table) and applies the same earnings-decline factor g=90/93.61=0.9614 to either anchor; since price=current_price*(multiple_new/multiple_current)*g and the ratio is 1 for any flat multiple, every anchor priced this way converges on $90 -- no cross-anchor disagreement

bear.probability_evidence: Bear is supported by concrete overhangs beyond simple earnings erosion: short interest is high and rising (13.55% of float, +2.3% MoM), Piotroski F-score is only 4, and repeated plaintiff-firm notices (8 since 2026-09-22) cite a securities-fraud investigation tied to the post-guidance-cut drop (factsheet-2026-10-07.md Other/News & sentiment; note section 6) -- these are specific negative-signal facts, but still a tail relative to the base continuation case.

target_price_12m.cite: evaluation.md Decision block scenarios.bear.target_price_12m: margin erosion extends and earnings reset lower at a flat multiple

target_band.cite: Half the spread of the bear target priced on a flat P/E (7.7x, factsheet Valuation table) with a generic earnings-decline factor g=65/93.61=0.6943 (giving $65 by construction) vs. the SAME flat P/FCF multiple (7.7x) but with the FCF-margin collapse the bear basis itself cites (FY2023 low of 4.0% vs 12.2% TTM, factsheet Quality table: factor 4.0/12.2=0.3279), giving 93.61*0.3279=$30.71: spread $34.29 / 2 / $65 target = 26.38%
